AirDroid is the TOP 1 comprehensive devices management tool which includes file transfer, file management, remote control, screen mirror, and notification management. Trusted by 500 million+ users worldwide, AirDroid is your first choice for a secure management app.

AirDroid provides the most convenient way to help you transfer files across different platforms, sharing and sending photos or files to family, friends, and co-workers is easy. 

With the powerful function of remotely controlling your devices, camera, keyboard, and screen, you will unlock an awesome tool that helps you on many occasions like office, study, etc.,

==KEY FEATURES==
•	File Transfer 
•	File Management
•	Device Remote Control
•	Device Remote Mirroring 
•	Camera Remote Control 
•	Backup photos and videos in a Tap
•	Messages, Calls & Contact Management 

TRANSFER & MANAGE FILES & FOLDERS 
•	Manage your files and create folders for all of your needs
•	Import files from your computer, web, or any nearby devices remotely
•	Manage files where you want
•	Up to 20Mb/s transfer speed
 
 REMOTE CONTROL DEVICES WITHOUT ROOT
•	Remote control devices without a USB cable
•	Screen remote control with no latency
•	Camera remote control is supported
•	Keyboard remote control is supported
•	Screen mirror in a tap

LAN CONTROL DEVICES BECOME MUCH EASIER
•	LAN files transfer in seconds
•	LAN control mobiles
•	LAN control camera
•	LAN device screen mirroring 

BROWSER REMOTE MANAGEMENT
•	Support all browsers
•	Web remote controls, screen mirror, notification management
•	Find devices, remote reset device's data 

DEVICES MANAGEMENT
•	Manage calls and SMS
•	Manage contacts in an easier way
•	Backup videos and photos in a click

SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK 
We are committed to open communication with our users. Before leaving a review, please get in touch with us first with any questions or support issues. We will respond and address your concern promptly. Contact us through our website https://www.airdroid.com/personal

android.desc: AirDroid is your best personal mobile device management suite, which is built on 10 years of non-stop improvements, including file transfer and management, screen mirroring, remote control, and receive SMS notifications right from your computer - all can be done with just one AirDroid app. Major features: 1. Enjoy hyper-fast file transferring without limitations You can use AirDroid to enjoy the incredibly fast file-transferring speed at 20MB/s, under both local and remote connections. Enjoy the uncompromising experience for productivity even when switching to Wi-Fi, 4G, or 5G network. The nearby feature also allows you to instantly and directly send photos & video files to your nearby friends, even without an account or internet connection. 2. All-in-one file management From the desktop client or the web client web.airdroid.com, you can check up and manage photos, videos, music, apps, storage, and more on your devices. You can even automatically sync and upload your photos & videos to your PC, that way you can not only save up your device's storage but also avoid the risk of having your privacy leaked. 3. Screen Mirroring Mirror your Android devices to pc wirelessly so that you can share your screen with your students or partners. You can also stream your broadcast with AirDroid, to share your games or pictures with your audience more efficiently. Screen mirroring doesn't require the phones and the computer to be on the same network. A practical solution for various scenarios. 4. Remote Control Android devices You can take full control of your Android devices, without rooting your devices, just need to connect to the AirDroid PC client for a fast setting, to do whatever you want to do on your Android devices remotely, ex, play games, open an app, check the phone status. Remote control for AirDroid is easy to set up and runs smoothly even if your device is on the other side of the globe. *If you need to remote control an Android device from another Android device, you need to download AirMirror for the controller device. 5. Remote Monitoring Make use of unused Android phones and have them be your eyes by using the remote camera feature. Monitor the device surroundings, or listen in on environmental sounds with One-Way Audio, so you don't need to stay on the screen at all times. You can check in on newborns and pets or safeguard your home, all without spending extra on new cameras. 5.

quotes.text: AirDroid is pretty handy on Android; file transfer, browsing your phone's files/images, sending SMS from your desktop browser (although Messages now does that native) etc. Much to my surprise, there's also an iOS version - https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1194539178
